basis_class: PROXY - Dukascopy USATECHIDXUSD BID-quote CFD. NOT CME NQ trades, NOT NQ order flow. Volume is broker-side.

ATR.note: identical to po3_engine.wilder_atr; one definition only

global.price_fields: RAW unquantized 5-minute BID OHLC from data_ndx/NDX_5m.csv. No rounding is applied. The V1 file data_ndx_q was irreversibly rounded to 0.25 and is NEVER read by V2.
global.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

level_age_min.note: age at CONFIRMATION, not at the sweep bar open - every baseline predictor row is the information set at t0

touch_count.formula: count of prior bars whose [low,high] intersects [level - PROXY_TOUCH_TOLERANCE_POINTS, level + PROXY_TOUCH_TOLERANCE_POINTS] strictly between LEVEL_AVAILABILITY_TIME and the sweep bar's open

level_prominence_atr.formula: |level - median(close over the 20 bars preceding LEVEL_AVAILABILITY_TIME)| / ATR_at_availability

competing_liquidity_atr.formula: min over all OTHER available levels of |other.price - level| / ATR_at_sweep; SAME SIDE only
competing_liquidity_atr.missing: cap (10.0) when no other same-side level exists

penetration_pts.formula: sell-side: level - low_of_sweep_bar ; buy-side: high_of_sweep_bar - level

close_vs_level_atr.note: REPLACES reclaim_magnitude_atr at event time. Positive = the sweep bar already closed back through the level BEFORE confirmation.

same_bar_reclaim.note: the only reclaim information knowable at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME

wick_body_ratio.formula: sell-side: (min(o,c) - l) / max(|c-o|, PROXY_BODY_FLOOR_POINTS) ; buy-side: (h - max(o,c)) / same denominator

vwap_slope_sigma_per_bar.missing: FEATURE MISSING / event ineligible for THIS feature when fewer than 12 completed bars since the VWAP anchor. Insufficient history is NOT a flat slope: zero means an observed flat slope, which is a different economic state. No adaptive shorter window.

atr_percentile.formula: percentile rank of ATR0 among same-bucket historical ATR values. BUCKET = the completed 5-minute bucket-of-CME-trade-day containing t0. REFERENCE = the Wilder ATR(14) value at that SAME 5m bucket on each of the preceding 252 eligible trade dates carrying a valid observation for it. Not end-of-day ATR, not a neighbouring bucket, never a future date.
atr_percentile.on_insufficient: fewer than 252 valid same-bucket comparators -> FEATURE MISSING / ineligible for this feature
atr_percentile.comparator_causality: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

realized_vol_state.formula: percentile rank of RV0 = sqrt(sum of squared 5m log returns over the 78 CLOSED bars ending at t0) among same-bucket historical values. REFERENCE = the corresponding 78-bar statistic ending at the SAME 5m bucket-of-trade-day on each of the preceding 252 eligible trade dates. Not end-of-day RV, not a neighbouring bucket.
realized_vol_state.on_insufficient: fewer than 252 valid same-bucket comparators -> FEATURE MISSING / ineligible for this feature
realized_vol_state.comparator_causality: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

range_compression.formula: (mean true range of the last 12 closed 5m bars) / (mean true range of the last 72 closed 5m bars)

dist_session_open_atr.formula: (close - open of the first bar of this CME trade day) / ATR

dist_weekly_open_atr.formula: (close - open of the first bar of the CME trade week, week starting with the Sunday 18:00 ET open) / ATR

dist_overnight_high_atr.formula: (close - max high over [18:00 ET, 09:30 ET) of this trade day) / ATR
dist_overnight_high_atr.available: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0), and only when t0 >= 09:30 ET
dist_overnight_high_atr.non_promotable_reason: development missingness 60.19% exceeds the frozen 20% gate. A property of the frozen definition (defined only after 09:30 ET); ACCEPTED, not repaired. Remains PREDECLARED, IN THE ORIGINAL FAMILY and DESCRIPTIVELY REPORTABLE. NON-PROMOTABLE regardless of its eventual p-value.

dist_overnight_low_atr.formula: (close - min low over [18:00 ET, 09:30 ET) of this trade day) / ATR
dist_overnight_low_atr.available: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0), and only when t0 >= 09:30 ET
dist_overnight_low_atr.non_promotable_reason: development missingness 60.19% exceeds the frozen 20% gate. A property of the frozen definition (defined only after 09:30 ET); ACCEPTED, not repaired. Remains PREDECLARED, IN THE ORIGINAL FAMILY and DESCRIPTIVELY REPORTABLE. NON-PROMOTABLE regardless of its eventual p-value.

htf_15m_compression.formula: (mean TR of last 4 CLOSED 15m bars)/(mean TR of last 16 CLOSED 15m bars)

htf_1h_range_pctile.formula: percentile of the range (high-low) of the newest fully CLOSED 1H bucket at t0. REFERENCE: the SAME bucket-of-trade-day from each of the previous 252 eligible trade dates where that bucket exists and is complete. An overnight bucket is compared only with overnight buckets. If fewer than 252 prior dates carry that bucket, the event is INELIGIBLE.
htf_1h_range_pctile.on_insufficient: fewer than 252 valid same-bucket comparators -> FEATURE MISSING / ineligible for this feature
htf_1h_range_pctile.comparator_causality: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

htf_1h_vol_state.formula: percentile of sqrt(sum of squared 1H log returns over the 24 CLOSED 1H bars ending at t0). REFERENCE: same bucket-of-trade-day comparator as htf_1h_range_pctile - one value per prior eligible trade date at the SAME bucket, never an arbitrary end-of-day bucket.
htf_1h_vol_state.on_insufficient: fewer than 252 valid same-bucket comparators -> FEATURE MISSING / ineligible for this feature
htf_1h_vol_state.comparator_causality: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

htf_1h_dist_ref_atr.formula: (close_of_last_CLOSED_1H_bar - REFERENCE) / ATR_1H, where REFERENCE is EXACTLY the open of the current CME trade day's first 1H bar
htf_1h_dist_ref_atr.reference: current CME trade-day 1H open - no other reference permitted

PROHIBITED_AT_EVENT_TIME.reclaim_latency_min: reclaim may occur AFTER confirmation - LANDMARK/OUTCOME only
PROHIBITED_AT_EVENT_TIME.htf_directional_agreement: H6 rejected it; prohibited under any name

landmark_features.origin: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0), NOT the sweep bar open
landmark_features.rule: at landmark L only information timestamped <= TL is usable
landmark_features.remaining_horizon: FIXED 30 minutes from TL for EVERY landmark
landmark_features.remaining_return: direction * (close at TL+30m - close at TL) / ATR0
landmark_features.atr_choice: ATR0 (the ATR known at t0) for ALL landmarks - frozen so the denominator cannot drift between landmarks
forbidden: any horizon other than 30m from TL

outcomes.C0: close of the confirmed sweep bar
outcomes.Y_H: direction * (C_H - C0) / ATR0, where C_H is the close of the bar whose CLOSE timestamp is EXACTLY t0 + H (stored open stamp + 300s)

MFE_MAE.bars_used: ONLY bars whose interval lies strictly AFTER t0 and whose close is <= t0+H. The sweep bar is EXCLUDED - its high/low may contain pre-confirmation movement.

secondary.vwap_reached: a post-confirmation bar's [low,high] contains the VWAP value FROZEN at t0. The future-drifting VWAP is never the target.
secondary.level_revisited: a post-confirmation bar's [low,high] contains the original swept level price
secondary.opposing_liquidity_reached: at t0 identify the nearest AVAILABLE opposite-side level under the frozen universe; freeze its id and price; outcome is whether post-confirmation price reaches that frozen price. A level formed later can NEVER retroactively become the target. None available -> N/A.

outcomes.censoring: data gap, maintenance hour, partition boundary or contract roll -> CENSORED. Never nearest-bar, previous-bar, next-available or interpolated substitution.

price_grid.raw_file: data_ndx/NDX_5m.csv - UNALTERED CFD quotes (only ~2% land on a 0.25 grid, i.e. genuinely unquantized)
price_grid.quantized_file: data_ndx_q/NDX_5m.csv - IRREVERSIBLY rounded to 0.25 by quantize_basis.py for V1. Retained for V1 reproducibility.
price_grid.V2_USES: data_ndx/NDX_5m.csv (RAW). V2 does NOT round CFD quotes to imitate an NQ tick grid.
price_grid.note: 0.25 is an NQ-like MINIMUM PENETRATION THRESHOLD applied to raw quotes. It is not the CFD's native tick and is never described as one.

timestamp_semantics.evidence: 18:00 ET stamps exist; a bar CLOSING at 18:00 would span 17:55-18:00, entirely inside the maintenance halt. Proven in test_v2_causality.py.
timestamp_semantics.SWEEP_BAR_OPEN_TIME: the stored stamp of the sweep bar
timestamp_semantics.SWEEP_TIME: DEPRECATED as a time. Structural bar identifier only; it is NOT the intrabar crossing instant, which 5m OHLC cannot reveal.

proxy_coverage_limitation: The CFD feed's last bar opens ~16:10 ET and it reopens 18:00 ET, so it does NOT cover 16:15-18:00 ET - of which 16:15-17:00 is genuine CME session time. The 'post' bucket is therefore sparse on this basis by construction.

excluded_from_confirmatory.dist_weekly_open_atr: exploratory - weekly-open information is contaminated by prior research exposure
excluded_from_confirmatory.direction: stratification/orientation variable, not an ordinary predictor

holm.continuous_test: rank(Y_30) = a + b*rank(X), CR1 by CME trade date; b's clustered two-sided p enters Holm
holm.boolean_test: Y_30 = a + b*B, CR1; b's clustered p
holm.categorical_test: rank(Y_30) on K-1 dummies, ONE clustered omnibus Wald (H0: all K-1 coefficients zero); that single p enters Holm. Individual category coefficients are DESCRIPTIVE only.
holm.rho_note: rho is DESCRIPTIVE effect size only; it supplies no p-value
holm.categorical_stability: centred category-effect vector (fitted mean rank outcome per category minus the UNWEIGHTED grand mean across eligible categories) - reference-invariant. Spearman rho of S1vsS2 and S2vsS3 both > 0. Same category set required in all three subperiods; <3 common -> INCONCLUSIVE and non-promotable. Categories are dropped only for sample availability.
holm.family_size_is_fixed: m = 22 ALWAYS. A predeclared feature that cannot produce a valid test is NOT TESTABLE / NOT PROMOTABLE; it is never replaced and m is never reduced - power must not be gained because a predeclared test failed to become usable.
holm.non_promotable_do_not_create_vacancies: the two overnight-distance features are NON-PROMOTABLE on missingness. They are NOT replaced, the family is NOT reduced, and no multiplicity power is gained from them. m = 22.

research_constants.note: FOUR separately named research constants imposed on the proxy. Their values coincide but they are NOT one symbol: changing sweep penetration must not silently change touch counting, wick geometry or pivot de-duplication. None is a property of the Dukascopy instrument, and none is a tick.

proxy_level_semantics: pdh/pdl/pwh/pwl and every session extremum are PROXY-OBSERVED extrema from Dukascopy CFD bars, NOT true CME NQ highs/lows. The feed omits ~16:15-18:00 ET, including 16:15-17:00 ET when NQ still trades, so a proxy extremum may differ from the real NQ level. The CME trade-date calendar partitions time; only prices come from observed proxy bars. The missing interval is NEVER filled synthetically. Every V2_PROXY report header must state this.

primary_population.rule: PRIMARY OUTCOME ELIGIBILITY is determined ONCE for all features, BEFORE any feature test. Feature availability is applied second.
conditions: D exact C_30 endpoint bar exists
E no data gap on the path
F horizon does not cross a partition boundary
H all other frozen censoring rules satisfied

censoring_audit.reads: OUTCOME AVAILABILITY ONLY - never the value or sign of Y_30
censoring_audit.rule: a categorical level joins the confirmatory design only with >=30 distinct CME trade-date clusters carrying primary-eligible events; otherwise excluded from inference and reported as insufficient coverage. Sample availability, never outcome performance.

hard_gates: continuous: full-development CR1 sign reproduced by the point estimate in S1, S2 AND S3; categorical: frozen stability rule
removed_subjective_gates: no domination by a handful of days
promotion.note: those phrases were not mechanical and created post-result discretion

robustness_diagnostics.status: REPORTED, never a Phase-1 pass/fail gate
robustness_diagnostics.year: CR1/rank effect by calendar year where sample permits
robustness_diagnostics.day_concentration: descriptive effect after excluding the top 1% of trade dates by absolute contribution to the association statistic
robustness_diagnostics.gapped_events: gap-excluded rerun is descriptive only; gapped events are INCLUDED in the primary analysis

quantile_algorithm.name: linear interpolation on order statistics (NumPy 'linear' / type 7)
quantile_algorithm.formula: for sorted x of size n and probability q: h=(n-1)*q ; j=floor(h) ; g=h-j ; Q = (1-g)*x[j] + g*x[j+1] if j+1<n else x[j]
quantile_algorithm.note: frozen explicitly so no library-version default can decide it silently

winsorization_freeze_rules.uses: valid causal event-time feature values only; missing burn-in values are NEVER imputed to estimate a quantile
winsorization_freeze_rules.on_insufficient: HALT and report before outcomes - no arbitrary constant
winsorization_freeze_rules.immutable_after_freeze: never recomputed from evaluable-development, validation, stress-set or outcome data

event_sweep_rule: A level emits AT MOST ONE sweep event: its FIRST penetration after availability. Without this a level price simply sits beyond re-fires every bar (measured 16.8 events/bar; pdl events carried a median age of 865 minutes, the same event counted 939 times). This is the reading the frozen spec already presupposes - touch_count counts bars 'strictly between availability and THE sweep bar's open', level_revisited exists as an OUTCOME, and the pivot rule already treats being swept as a state change. Measured effect: 70,694 -> 404 events on a 16-day sample, 25.2 per trade day.

event_state_machine.identity: each level carries an immutable identity for its whole lifetime
event_state_machine.rule: A level produces EXACTLY ONE baseline sweep event: the first bar after LEVEL_AVAILABILITY_TIME satisfying the frozen qualifying-penetration rule. On emission has_emitted_sweep := true, irreversibly.

qualifying_penetration.equality: equality to the level without the required penetration is NOT a sweep

never_re_emits_when: price remains beyond the level for several bars
price moves away and later trades through it again
event_state_machine.post_event_path: those behaviours belong to the POST-EVENT PATH of the original event and may feed the frozen outcomes: reclaim, level revisit, MFE, MAE, opposing-liquidity interaction. They are NOT new baseline events.
event_state_machine.new_events_only_via: a genuinely distinct level created under the frozen level-generation rules, receiving a NEW immutable identity
explicitly_forbidden: re-arm after price moves X ATR away
regeneration of the same identity after N minutes
event_state_machine.measured_justification: the prior unspecified behaviour let an already-penetrated level fire on every subsequent qualifying bar: ~16.8 events/bar in diagnosis, individual levels firing hundreds of times. 16-day sample 70,694 -> 404 events, ~25.2/trade day across the 11 frozen liquidity classes.
event_state_machine.counts_are_not_targets: 404 / 5,875 are observations, not optimisation targets. The event definition is NOT tuned toward any events-per-day figure, and eventual trade frequency is irrelevant at this stage: an event study is expected to carry far more candidate events than a strategy.

missingness_gate.measured_on: the development evaluable population, per PROTOCOL_V2_CANONICAL section 10 ('every univariate result ... percent missing'). Burn-in missingness is reported alongside but cannot govern the four 252-day percentile features, which are 100% missing in burn-in BY CONSTRUCTION because burn-in is exactly the window that builds their comparators.
missingness_gate.applied_literally: threshold frozen before any result: not tightened, not rounded up, no safety margin
